content.value: An instruction in address $( 0 A B ) _ { 1 6 }$ in the computer has the operation-code of ADD instruction and an address Port $( 0 C D ) _ { 1 6 }$ . The memory word of address $( 0 C D ) _ { 1 6 }$ contains $( A B C D ) _ { 1 6 } .$ Register A contains $( 0 1 0 1 ) _ { 1 6 }$ . Tabulate the contents of register PC, MAR, B, A, and I after the instruction is executed. Repeat the problem two more times for operations AND and STO.
